workflows.name: Daily Card/E-Wallet Settlement File Ingestion & GL Posting

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-validate of "validates file integrity and partner authentication" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-count of "Accountant posts settlement to clearing GL" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-match of "matches bank statement credit" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - operational: schema validation and partner pre-notification
Pain Points / Risks: - **Reconciliation risk**: File format/schema changes break ingestion; mitigated by schema validation and partner pre-notification
System Touchpoints: - Settlement file ingestion; clearing GL; bank statement import; multi-currency module

steps.activity: IT ingests daily settlement files (EDI/CSV/API) from each acquirer and e-wallet into ERP settlement staging; validates file integrity and partner authentication
AR Settlement Accountant posts settlement to clearing GL: gross captured, fees deducted, net bank credit; maps each batch by MID/entity/store
Finance validates net settlement matches bank statement credit; investigates timing differences (T+1 vs. T+2) and currency (USD card settlements)

fields.Participants: AR Settlement Accountant, Store Ops, IT

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-record of "records to POS capture by reference" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-count of "Accountant triages exceptions" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-send of "resend batch, manual settlement, RFI to acquirer" (replaces manual Step 3).
Pain Points / Risks: - **Leakage risk**: Unreconciled exceptions over-state receivables; mitigated by daily SLA-bound triage
System Touchpoints: - Auto-match engine; exception queue; terminal monitoring

steps.activity: ERP auto-matches settlement records to POS capture by reference (RRN/auth code/QR ref); flags unmatched captures and unmatched settlements
AR Settlement Accountant triages exceptions: terminal batch not closed, declined-but-captured, duplicate capture, missing settlement; assigns owner
Store Ops/IT resolves terminal-level issues (resend batch, manual settlement, RFI to acquirer); AR Settlement Accountant clears exception queue
steps.r: Store Ops / IT / AR Settlement Accountant

fields.Participants: Cashier, Store Manager, Payment Ops Manager
fields.Trigger: Shift change and end-of-day per terminal

workflows.name: Mid-Batch / End-of-Day Terminal Close & Capture Totals Validation

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-generate of "prints batch totals per tender" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-validate of "validates capture totals vs." (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-escalate of "escalates terminals with unclosed batches beyond SLA to prevent settlement delay" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - operational: SLA monitoring and manager escalation
Pain Points / Risks: - **Operational risk**: Unclosed batches delay settlement and cash flow; mitigated by SLA monitoring and manager escalation
System Touchpoints: - POS terminal batch management; Z-report; chain-wide batch monitor

steps.activity: Cashier initiates terminal batch close (settlement) at shift/day end; prints batch totals per tender; reconciles to POS Z-report
Store Manager validates capture totals vs. physical evidence (signed charge slips, e-wallet confirmation); investigates variances; re-batches if needed
Payment Ops Manager monitors chain-wide batch-close completion rate; escalates terminals with unclosed batches beyond SLA to prevent settlement delay

fields.Frequency: Event-driven; ~300–500 chargebacks/year (~0.003% of card txns, per the ~30–40/month Volume)
fields.Participants: Chargeback Analyst, Store Ops, LP, AR Settlement

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-log of "logs in dispute tracker" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-compile of "Store Ops/LP compiles compendium" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-submit of "submits representment via acquirer portal within scheme deadline" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - operational: SLA-bounded tracker and reminder workflow
Pain Points / Risks: - **Financial risk**: Missed representment deadline forfeits right to recover; mitigated by SLA-bounded tracker and reminder workflow
System Touchpoints: - Acquirer dispute portal; dispute tracker; evidence repository; loss-recovery GL

steps.activity: Chargeback Analyst receives chargeback (fraud, friendly fraud, product not received, duplicate); logs in dispute tracker; pulls POS transaction evidence
Store Ops/LP compiles compendium: signed charge slip, ID presented, CCTV timestamp, delivery proof/POD, BIR invoice, customer communication; assembles representment package
Chargeback Analyst submits representment via acquirer portal within scheme deadline (typically 7–45 days); tracks outcome; books chargeback loss or reversal

fields.Participants: Chargeback Analyst, LP, Legal, Payment Ops Manager
fields.Trigger: Issuer retrieval request or fraud alert from scheme

workflows.name: Retrieval Request, Fraud Alert & Pre-Arbitration Handling

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-record of "records for potential chargeback" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-count of "counterfeit card, account takeover, card testing" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-escalate of "escalates pre-arbitration cases to acquirer legal" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-470 (ensure controlled execution — Settlement Reconciliation & Chargeback/Dispute Management (PA-80.2).)
- operational: 24-hour SLA and LP-Payment Ops joint protocol
Pain Points / Risks: - **Fraud risk**: Late fraud alert response increases exposure; mitigated by 24-hour SLA and LP-Payment Ops joint protocol
System Touchpoints: - Scheme/acquirer fraud alert feed; LP case management; arbitration tracker

steps.activity: Chargeback Analyst responds to retrieval request with transaction documentation within scheme SLA; preserves records for potential chargeback
LP investigates fraud alerts ( counterfeit card, account takeover, card testing); blocks terminals/merchants if compromise suspected
Payment Ops Manager escalates pre-arbitration cases to acquirer legal; coordinates scheme dispute resolution; books arbitration loss if unfavorable

fields.Participants: AR Settlement Accountant, Customer Service, Store Ops

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-generate of "generates reversal reference" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-match of "matches reversal to original capture" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-count of "Accountant reconciles reversal settlement to bank debit" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-470 (ensure controlled execution — Settlement Reconciliation & Chargeback/Dispute Management (PA-80.2).)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Reconciliation risk**: Refund processed but not settled (or vice versa) distorts receivables; mitigated by auto-match and daily reconciliation
System Touchpoints: - POS refund workflow; reversal match engine; refund liability GL

steps.activity: Customer Service processes refund to original tender in POS/ecommerce; generates reversal reference; ensures within scheme refund window
ERP auto-matches reversal to original capture; ensures settlement deduction equals refund; flags unmatched reversals for investigation
AR Settlement Accountant reconciles reversal settlement to bank debit; books refund liability and clears customer receivable; resolves timing differences

fields.Participants: Finance Analyst, Payment Ops Manager, FP&A

workflows.name: Payment Fee & Interchange Cost Allocation to Store/Channel

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-allocate of "allocates payment fees" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-report of "reports tender mix trend and cost-per-transaction to management" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-470 (ensure controlled execution — Settlement Reconciliation & Chargeback/Dispute Management (PA-80.2).)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Cost risk**: Cash-heavy mix incurs CIT/cash-office cost; mitigated by tender-mix optimization incentives
System Touchpoints: - Cost allocation engine; store P&L module; tender analytics dashboard

steps.activity: Finance Analyst allocates payment fees (MDR, e-wallet fee, BNPL fee, chargeback loss) to originating store/channel based on transaction-level capture data
FP&A incorporates net payment cost into store P&L and category gross margin analysis; benchmarks cost-to-serve by tender/channel
Payment Ops Manager reports tender mix trend and cost-per-transaction to management; recommends migration incentives (e.g., e-wallet promo to reduce cash handling)

fields.Participants: AR Settlement Accountant, Finance, Payment Ops Manager
fields.Trigger: Items aged > 30 days in settlement suspense

workflows.name: Aged Unreconciled Settlement & Suspense GL Clearing

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-review of "reviews aged settlement suspense weekly" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-flag for investigation of "investigates root cause with acquirer/partner" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-report of "reports aged suspense trend and root-cause themes to management for systemic…" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-470 (ensure controlled execution — Settlement Reconciliation & Chargeback/Dispute Management (PA-80.2).)
- operational: 30/60/90 aging discipline and write-off governance
Pain Points / Risks: - **Financial risk**: Unmanaged suspense distorts financials and signals control weakness; mitigated by 30/60/90 aging discipline and write-off governance
System Touchpoints: - Aged suspense report; write-off provisioning; root-cause tracker

steps.activity: AR Settlement Accountant reviews aged settlement suspense weekly; classifies (acquirer error, timing, write-off candidate); assigns resolution owner
Finance investigates root cause with acquirer/partner; recovers where possible; provisions write-off for unrecoverable items > 90 days
Payment Ops Manager closes suspense items; reports aged suspense trend and root-cause themes to management for systemic remediation
